title: Euler's Identity
subtitle: Complex Analysis · Five fundamental constants
summary: Combines e, i, π, 1, and 0 in a single equation.
detail:
\[ e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0 \]

Follows from Euler's formula \(e^{i\theta}=\cos\theta+i\sin\theta\) at \(\theta=\pi\). Unites the five most fundamental constants in mathematics: \(e\), \(i\), \(\pi\), \(1\), \(0\).
